name: run_full_pipeline
description: End-to-end OT-2 pipeline: generate a protocol script from a natural-language task description, simulate it, analyze it for optimization opportunities, and produce all visualisation outputs (PDF, HTML, GIF, stats PNG). Returns a combined JSON summary of all four stages.

inputs.name: task_type
inputs.description: Protocol category. Must be one of: serial_dilution, pcr_setup, rt_normalization.

inputs.name: parameters_json
inputs.description: JSON string of task-specific parameters. See SKILL.md for per-task schemas.

outputs.name: result
outputs.description: JSON string with run_id, status, and a 'stages' object containing generate/simulate/analyze/visualize sub-results.
